review: Tried to used the QR code scanner for the on going Monopoly thing and when it scans the code nothing happens and when I try to add it manually nothing happens
Do not like that they need location services on to use the app.

Zero stars if I could. I can't order ahead using tablet. App is absurdly slow. Offers won't load. Location services permission must be granted access to always on meaning app is continually tracking you. So not worth my time and privacy just for a free Big Mac which is now tiny (I remember the weight of the patty was much more than now). iOS version is just as sluggish and lacks responsiveness. After all the profits, I would've expected McDonald's to hire competent software developers.
Performance of the app has increased, but how am I still not able to do "Light" anything? Why 0-1-2-3?
